newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary sells Ajka alumina to domestic bidder - APV.
newsitem.headline: Hungary sells Ajka alumina to domestic bidder - APV.

text.p: Hungarian privatisation agency APV Rt said on Wednesday it had decided to sell the Ajka alumina plant to a domestic bidder, Inotai Aluminium Kft.
APV general director Pal Szabo told a news conference that the other bid, submitted by a consortium of Norsk Hydro and Slovakia's ZSNP Ziar Nad Hronom, was deemed invalid.
Szabo added the sale price was 10 million forints but that the company's actual market value was minus five billion forints.
"We could in fact say that the company was sold for 5.01 billion forints," he said.
Inotai also undertook to finish environmental investments of three billion forints, developments worth four billion forints and to maintain Ajka's 900-strong workforce.
